title: Seoul seeks way out of N. Korean POW dispute with Ukraine as apology standoff persists
caption:
South Korea has recalled its ambassador to Kyiv after a disagreement over the public disclosure of North Korean prisoners of war. The two nations are now seeking a diplomatic compromise to end the impasse.
